validation.note: Offline only. Both current source originals and staging backups matched hashes; all variants decoded and matched manifest dimensions. No network or cloud mutations.

letterBrowser.note: Local Chrome, network restricted to loopback; contact sheets rendered offline. Checks native image document opened by keyboard, not physical mobile pinch gestures.

limits: No cloud upload, original deletion, production source switch or deployment.
Staging originals are temporary working copies, not durable private Storage archives.
PC three-view candidates are quality evaluation only and excluded from the upload manifests.
Visual assessment uses contact sheets for all 39 three views and native-resolution crops/full images for selected details; not every image has been inspected at every magnification.
Mobile testing uses a 390px Chrome viewport, not physical device pinch gestures.
